title: Execution Tasks
assumptions: Task IDs are ordered for sequential execution when two tasks touch the same file.
Historical references inside `docs/plans/**` and the superseded ADR `docs/adrs/0003-worktree-backend-entrypoint-and-env-contract.md` may remain; other living code and docs must be updated.
All commands are run from the repository root unless a task explicitly says otherwise.
Tasks stay intentionally narrow so a low-reasoning implementation model can complete and verify each unit without needing broader repo context.

tasks.goal: Make the devcontainer service contract match the new `dev-sandbox` runtime model and remove PostgreSQL host-port publishing.
constraints: Rename the compose service key `app` to `dev-sandbox`.
Keep the repository bind mount `..:/workspace` and `command: sleep infinity` unchanged.
Publish the backend port from container to host using `DJANGO_DEV_PORT`; do not hard-code a numeric port.
Keep PostgreSQL reachable on the compose network by service name, but remove any host `5432` port mapping.
Set `devcontainer.json` `service` to `dev-sandbox` and keep `postCreateCommand` as `bash .devcontainer/bootstrap.sh`.
acceptance_criteria: `.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml` defines `services.dev-sandbox` and no longer defines `services.app`.
`.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml` contains a `ports` mapping for `dev-sandbox` that uses `DJANGO_DEV_PORT` for both host and container sides.
`.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml` does not contain `5432:5432` and the `postgres` service has no host port mapping.
`.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` sets `"service": "dev-sandbox"` and still references `docker-compose.yml` plus `bash .devcontainer/bootstrap.sh`.
implementation_notes: Verify by reading both files after the edit; no runtime command is required for this task.
Do not introduce any user-facing `docker compose up` instructions here; this task is config-only.

tasks.goal: Rewrite the tracked devcontainer environment example to document the new localhost-plus-port contract.
constraints: Keep only the minimum local variables required by the plan: `DJANGO_DEV_PORT`, `ALLOWED_HOSTS`, `POSTGRES_HOST`, `POSTGRES_PORT`, `POSTGRES_DB`, `POSTGRES_USER`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, and `DATABASE_URL`.
Remove `DJANGO_DEV_HOST` and `DJANGO_DEV_BASE_URL` from the example.
Set `ALLOWED_HOSTS` to a localhost-oriented value that includes `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, and `[::1]`.
Keep `POSTGRES_HOST=postgres` and `POSTGRES_PORT=5432` so the file documents the compose-network contract.
acceptance_criteria: `.devcontainer/.env.example` contains the eight required variables named in the constraints.
`.devcontainer/.env.example` does not contain `DJANGO_DEV_HOST=` or `DJANGO_DEV_BASE_URL=`.
The example `DATABASE_URL` points at the `postgres` service rather than `localhost`.
implementation_notes: Keep the file as a plain `.env` example with one assignment per line.
Do not add extra optional variables; the objective is a minimal, explicit contract.

Update the `help` description so it says this command starts the backend inside the devcontainer rather than for the current worktree on the host.
Do not add any PID file, lock file, stop wrapper, or status wrapper behavior.
acceptance_criteria: `Makefile` no longer contains `./scripts/start-server.sh`.
The `backend-run` recipe includes `python manage.py migrate`, a `python manage.py shell -c` call importing `ensure_admin_user_from_env`, and `python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:${DJANGO_DEV_PORT}`.
`make help` describes `backend-run` as a devcontainer-local backend start command.
implementation_notes: Keep the command sequence explicit in the Makefile; do not hide it behind a new wrapper script.
Preserve execution from the repository root by using `cd backend && ...`.

tasks.goal: Replace the extension worktree build flow with a simple runtime-config generator and updated package scripts.
constraints: Create `extension/scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs` that rewrites `extension/chrome/runtime-config.js` in place.
The generator input contract must be: use `WEBCLIPPINGS_API_BASE_URL` if set, otherwise derive `http://localhost:${DJANGO_DEV_PORT}` and default the port to `8000` when unset.
The generated output format must be a single `globalThis.WEBCLIPPINGS_RUNTIME_CONFIG = { apiBaseUrl: "<origin>" };` assignment plus trailing newline.
Remove `prepare:worktree`, `build:worktree`, and `test:e2e:worktree` from `extension/package.json`.
Add a `prepare:runtime-config` script and make both `test:e2e` and `test:a11y` run it before Playwright.
acceptance_criteria: `extension/package.json` contains `prepare:runtime-config` and does not contain `prepare:worktree`, `build:worktree`, or `test:e2e:worktree`.
Running `node extension/scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs` updates `extension/chrome/runtime-config.js` without creating any `.local` files.
`extension/chrome/runtime-config.js` remains a small checked-in file containing only the global runtime-config assignment.
implementation_notes: Keep `build` as the TypeScript compile step only.
The generator should normalize any provided `WEBCLIPPINGS_API_BASE_URL` to its URL origin.

tasks.goal: Update the extension manifest and config helpers for localhost development across arbitrary backend ports with an explicit manifest fallback contract.
constraints: Preserve the precedence order in `config.ts`: runtime config first, manifest fallback second, hard-coded fallback last.
Replace the manifest local-development host permission `http://localhost:8000/*` with exactly `http://localhost/*` and `http://127.0.0.1/*`.
Keep manifest fallback behavior as 'first valid host permission in manifest order'.
Update unit tests to cover runtime override, localhost manifest fallback, invalid runtime override fallback, and hard-coded fallback when no valid host permission exists.
acceptance_criteria: `extension/chrome/manifest.json` contains `http://localhost/*`, `http://127.0.0.1/*`, and does not contain `http://localhost:8000/*`.
`extension/chrome/src/shared/config.ts` still prefers `WEBCLIPPINGS_RUNTIME_CONFIG.apiBaseUrl`, then returns the first valid manifest host origin, then falls back to `http://localhost:8000`.
`extension/chrome/src/shared/config.test.ts` asserts all four required cases explicitly.
implementation_notes: Prefer localhost-oriented permissions such as `http://localhost/*` and `http://127.0.0.1/*` over enumerating many fixed ports.
Do not remove the final hard-coded fallback; keep it as the last-resort path.
